mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install pathway lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of pathway lighting installation depends on the scope and complexity of the project. A smaller, straightforward installation with fewer fixtures and accessible wiring may be completed within a day or two. Larger, more intricate systems involving extensive trenching, custom fixture placement, or complex electrical work could take several days to a week. Factors such as weather conditions and the need for specialized equipment can also influence the timeline. Our team provides an estimated completion time after the initial site assessment.
